messages:
cheng: Heads-up — starting SilverLake LoRA merge bring-up. They handed us a ~2k-step LoRA trained on legal docs. Plan: merge adapter, then int4 quantize for Dedicated pool. Need a quick eval pack (50 prompts) + tokenizer sanity check. Who can take the eval pack?

maya: I got this. Do we have their prompt seeds? Any sensitive redactions needed?

ryan: seed bundle in s3: s3://redwood-cust/silverlake/lora_v1/prompts_vA.tar.gz. I'll add ACLs for eng-ml. No PII in seeds per initial scan.

maya: perfect. I'll run baseline fp16 and int4 after merge. Targets: latency p95 < 120ms. Metrics: BLEU/ROUGE + legal accuracy probes + hallucination rate.

cheng: add hallucination/regression probes — reuse cust-zenith harness. Weight priorities: semantic fidelity > micro-BLEU.

eva (deploy-bot): Deploy started: branch=ml/onboard/silverlake-lora commit=af3c2d ETA ~12m

ryan: quick note — adapter shifts tokenizer offsets on abbreviations (e.g., "sec.", "art."). Found +2 token shift for some cases. Patching preprocessing shim: `text = text.replace('sec. ', 'sec.  ')` for now, will propose tokenizer remap.

maya: running smoke eval now. quick results: 
```
model variant: silverlake-lora-merged
fp16 - BLEU: 27.4 | ROUGE-L: 48.2 | Hallucination rate: 4.8%
int4  - BLEU: 26.9 | ROUGE-L: 47.6 | Hallucination rate: 7.2%
latency (p95): fp16 98ms | int4 72ms
```

cheng: 7.2% hallucination on int4 is a red flag. What's the dominant failure mode?

maya: eyeballing diffs — punctuation drops that collapse clauses, sometimes missing legal connectors. Looks like token alignment + kv-cache quant noise.

ryan: suggestions: warm KV cache with 2-turn prefix, enable per-layer quant calibration (`calib=high`), or try a 4-bit GPTQ variant. I'll kick a quant job with `calib=high`.

maya: re-ran int4 with `calib=high` — hallucination down to 5.1%, BLEU recovered. New snippet:
```
int4+calib - BLEU: 27.1 | ROUGE-L: 48.0 | Hallucination: 5.1% | p95: 78ms
```

cheng: that's acceptable as a canary baseline. Action items: run full 50-prompt pack overnight, record per-prompt regressions, and schedule a Dedicated canary with automatic fallback to fp16 if hallucination > 6% or BLEU delta > -1.0.

maya: filed ticket INFER-7823 with logs, eval artifacts, and diffed outputs. tagging @oncall-ml for canary watch.

ryan: ACLs updated, artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-results/silverlake/onboard/1765439999/

opsbot: :thumbsup:
